I didn't run `dt build resolve` on them, because that could change how they're recorded and you asked me to leave them as they are. If you want the decision on record, so that a later session doesn't treat them as open, I can run `dt build resolve` on each with your words as the note.

The session hook also says the roadmap's Status column is out of date. `dt roadmap` refreshes it, but I left it alone so the branch stays exactly as the build left it.
